name: boote
description: Context-free (but context-required) idea incubator for Claude Code. Pressure-tests a raw idea stage by stage like an experienced YC/Techstars mentor: tracks each idea on a 7-rung validation ladder and gates progress on real user evidence — clarify, critique hard (no flattery), run grounded deep research (Gemini), refine, build a financial model and economic verdict, name and brand it, then produce a one-page memo and an interactive HTML deck before you graduate or park it. Discovers and requires the host project's own strategy, principles, risks, and hurdle (set up via `boote init`) — no hardcoded company data.
